table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	documentcode = Case h.adjcatcode WHEN 1 THEN 'AI-' ELSE 'AD-' END + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(h.AdjCode, 10))), 
	H.Date,
	H.AdjCode, 
	U.UserName,
	ItemName=I.name,
	AliasName=I.CustomICode,
	Price=Case :ai_pricetype
		WHEN 2 THEN Round(D.purprice / D.PackUnits, 2)
		WHEN 1 THEN Round(D.Saleprice / D.PackUnits, 2)
		WHEN 3 THEN Round(D.avgprice, 2)
		END,
	IncreaseQty = ISNULL(SUM(CASE H.AdjCatCode WHEN 1 THEN looseqty ELSE 0 END), 0),
	DecreaseQty = ISNULL(SUM(CASE H.AdjCatCode WHEN 2 THEN looseqty ELSE 0 END), 0),
	IncreaseValue = ISNULL(SUM(CASE H.AdjCatCode WHEN 1 THEN looseqty * 
		Case :ai_pricetype
			WHEN 2 THEN Round(D.purprice / D.PackUnits, 2)
			WHEN 1 THEN Round(D.Saleprice / D.PackUnits, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN Round(D.avgprice, 2)
			END ELSE 0 END), 0),
	DecreaseValue = ISNULL(SUM(CASE H.AdjCatCode WHEN 2 THEN looseqty * 
		Case :ai_pricetype
			WHEN 2 THEN Round(D.purprice / D.PackUnits, 2)
			WHEN 1 THEN Round(D.Saleprice / D.PackUnits, 2)
			WHEN 3 THEN Round(D.avgprice, 2)
			END ELSE 0 END), 0),
	Godown=G.Name

FROM
	AdjHeader H, 
	AdjDetail D,
	Item I,
	Users U,
	Godown G
WHERE
	H.AdjCode = D.AdjCode AND
	H.Date >= :ad_startdate AND H.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
	D.ICode = :ai_icode AND
	D.ICode = I.ICode AND
	D.GCode = G.GCode AND
	H.UserCode = U.UserCode
GROUP BY
	H.Date,
	H.AdjCode,
	h.adjcatcode,
	U.UserName,
	I.name,
	I.CustomICode,
	D.PurPrice,
	D.SalePrice,
	D.AvgPrice,
	D.Packunits,
	G.Name
Order By
	H.Date,
	H.AdjCode,
	U.UserName,
	I.name,
	I.CustomICode
table.sort: date A, adjcode A, user A, itemname A, aliasname A

objects.name: price_t
objects.text: case(  ai_pricetype  when 2 then 'Purchase Price' when 1 then 'Sale Price' ELSE 'Avg. Price')
